author: Adrian Lipa
core_prediction: The three-point tetrahedral base is the lowest member of a broader polygonal excitation hierarchy.
Excitation may permit base cardinalities N=4,5,6,... with no finite upper level assumed at freeze time.
Projection of the pole-to-polygon hierarchy onto the Poincare disk may generate discrete orbital-like states.
The resulting hierarchy may map onto atomic-orbital structure.
